newsitem.title: JAPAN: J.P. Morgan unit says will buy TSE membership.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan unit says will buy TSE membership.

text.p: J.P Morgan Securities Asia Ltd, a unit of J.P. Morgan & Co Inc, announced on Wednesday that it had signed a contract with a Japanese brokerage to buy a membership on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE).
The membership will be transferred from Osaka-based Daika Securities Co Ltd, which is due to merge with Tokyo-based Maruko Securities Co Ltd on October 1.
A J.P. Morgan spokeswoman declined to disclose details.
The Singapore-based brokerage said in a statement that it still needs to win approval at a TSE board meeting slated for September in order to become a TSE member.
The spokeswoman said a preparation period, probably for several months, may be needed before the brokerage starts actual operations after winning the board's approval.
J.P Morgan Securities Asia has branches in Tokyo and Osaka.
